title: Customer Engagement Deck — Modular Narrative & Renewal Playbook (Standard + Enterprise)
abstract: Modular QBR deck templates designed to be swapped into customer briefing flows quickly. Focus: align executive narrative to renewal decisions, surface a compact set of health signals, and provide an action-oriented renewal playbook. Includes two variants (Standard and Enterprise) plus an editable renewal tracker format and escalation ladder. Purpose is to reduce prep time, standardize success conversations, and increase predictable renewals.
sections: 1. Opening narrative: 'Customer story in 90 seconds' — one-slide summary of commitments, ROI signal, and the near-term ask (renewal/expansion). Speaker intent: set expectation and decision horizon.

2. Executive health snapshot (one pager) — consolidated KPIs: adoption trend, core usage, error/failure rate, latency (if applicable), cost per inference signal. Color-coded trend bands and a short interpretation line.
3. Business outcomes mapping — three rows: Objective (customer), Current state, Redwood contribution. Call out measurable metrics and owners for each outcome.
4. Renewal Health Delta — shows delta since last QBR across risk vectors (adoption, ROI, technical debt, enablement). Includes a small table for recent wins and unresolved blockers.

5. Adoption deep-dive (standard) — feature-level usage, example customer flows, example prompts / top templates consumers use. For enterprise, expand to multi-team adoption map and cross-functional stakeholders.

6. Performance & reliability appendix — SLO/SLA status, recent incidents, mean time to recovery, and mitigation actions. Include a one-line verdict for execs: green / amber / red plus recommended next action.

7. Cost and efficiency snapshot — per-feature cost trends and suggested Optimize levers (batching, cache, quantization). For enterprise customers include projected cost delta under reserved capacity / Dedicated.
8. Success stories & case micros — 2–3 short citations of wins achieved since last review (metrics + a short quote). Use these as momentum anchors in renewal conversations.

9. Risk register & mitigation plan — prioritize top 3 risks to renewal with owners and dates for mitigations. Include 'Decision Compass' indicating what decision preserves renewal (e.g., product fix vs. enablement vs. pricing concession).

10. Renewal cadence & playbook (action-oriented) — week-by-week play for next 90 days ahead of renewal: stakeholder outreach map, exec touchpoints, technical remediation sprints, and success metrics tied to renewal friction points.

11. Ask slide (explicit) — recommended renewal proposal (term, price tier, credits/discounts), optional add-ons (Dedicated, Private), and clear next steps. Always include 'decision date' and 'fallback plan' on the slide.
12. Appendix: technical capacity plan & runbook — for enterprise customers include deployment topology, forecasted throughput, required GPU reservations, and RACI for incident escalation.
13. One-page follow-up template — email-ready summary to send within 24 hours with decisions, action owners, and timeline (copyable into Slack/Confluence).
deck_variants: Standard variant: 10–12 slides, lean metrics, aimed at product and ops sponsors. Emphasis on adoption + ROI + explicit ask.

Enterprise variant: 15–18 slides, includes technical appendix, legal/compliance snapshot, dedicated capacity economics, and multi-stakeholder stakeholder map. More conservative recommendations, three-tier renewal options.
Executive one-pager: distilled 1-slide summary for CEO/CRO with single numeric health score and top 2 asks.
renewal_tracker_format: Single-line per customer with fields: renewal-date; decision-owner; risk-score (1-10); last-contact; current-offer; required-actions; next-touch-date; escalation-ladder. Stored as a shared sheet and synced to Jira tickets for each action.
Suggested sync cadence: weekly automated export to CS-ops and a biweekly deal-review meeting for anything with risk-score >= 6.
playbook_triggers: Trigger A — Usage drop > 20% month-over-month: open enablement sprint + outreach within 48 hours.
Trigger B — Technical incident affecting latency/SLO: immediate Triage + 72-hour remediation plan; assign SRE and solutions engineer.
Trigger C — Exec disengagement (no exec contact in 90 days): schedule re-engagement workshop and executive briefing pack.
sample_slide_notes: Opening: 'Start with the customer outcome — not our product. One sentence quantifying impact. If you can’t say the number, call it out as a data gap and propose a short data sprint.'
Health snapshot: 'Explain anomalies — use the top-right quarter to map if metrics are forward- or backward-looking. Keep visuals simple: 3 lines max.'
Risk register: 'Always assign an owner and a target date. If mitigation requires engineering, add a stub Jira ticket link on the slide.'
Ask slide: 'Offer a clear yes/no choice + a conservative fallback. Executives dislike fuzzy asks.'
Follow-up: 'Send the one-pager within 24 hours and create a Jira action for each owner with due dates. Copy legal/finance only when the ask includes pricing changes.'
prep_checklist: Gather data feeds: usage, billing, support tickets, incident logs (last 90 days).
Confirm attendee list and decision-maker present date (lock before slide build).
Draft executive one-pager and internal rehearsal notes.
Prepare technical appendix and have SRE/solutions engineer on standby for live Q&A.
Create follow-up Jira tasks and pre-populate renewal tracker row.
